description: This file defines types and functions related to parsing and handling fence spans (sections enclosed by fence markers) in markdown-like text buffers. It provides utilities for detecting fence spans, locating spans at specific indices, and checking if a given position is a safe fence break.

methods.name: export function parseFenceSpans(buffer: string): FenceSpan[] { parseFenceSpans
methods.description: Parses a markdown buffer to identify all fence spans (sections enclosed by fence markers such as ``` or ~~~). Returns an array of FenceSpan objects with start/end positions and marker info.

methods.name: export function findFenceSpanAt(spans: FenceSpan[], index: number): FenceSpan | undefined { findFenceSpanAt
methods.description: Given a list of FenceSpan objects and an index, determines which span contains that index, if any.

methods.name: export function isSafeFenceBreak(spans: FenceSpan[], index: number): boolean { isSafeFenceBreak
methods.description: Checks if a given index is not inside any fence span, implying a safe location to break or insert content.
